items.question: How should the practitioner place and draw in air at the root of tongue and palate?
items.inference: The verse prescribes a slow inward drawing of air after placing it at the tongue-palate root.
uncertainties: exact physiological mapping is not specified
items.plain_english: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it in slowly.

items.question: What happens to old age and death when this practice is sustained for one year?
premises: old age and death are named
items.inference: Sustained practice for one year destroys old age and death.
uncertainties: scope of destruction is not elaborated
items.plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.

items.question: Does poison enter the body even when one is bitten by great serpents?
premises: biting by great serpents is included
items.inference: The verse claims poison does not enter the body, even if bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: whether this is literal or yogic protection is not specified
items.plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
